items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The name 'Nathaniel' refers to the interviewee's own birth name, not a separate person.

ctx.x: I was born on June 10th, 1925, in Boston, Massachusetts, where I grew up until I came to New York in 1953 as the New York editor of Down Beat. I wrote about those interim years in a book called Boston Boy. Boston at the time won a prize, if that’s the word for it, as the most anti-Semitic city in the country.
Nat, what was your name at birth? Was it Nat Hentoff, or Nathaniel?
